privileged_info_for_vlm: The distance between Asp545 CA in 1ERE and 1ERR should be approximately 16.8 Angstroms (valid range 14.0 to 24.0). The agonist ligand in 1ERE is Estradiol (EST) and the antagonist in 1ERR is 4-Hydroxytamoxifen (OHT). Helix 12 undergoes a large conformational change from a 'closed' position (agonist) to an 'open/displaced' position (antagonist) that blocks co-activator binding.
